Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of SCHW.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $1.79 per share.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 13% to 19% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2023.
Our gross margin expanded by 98 basis points to 69.4%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 98 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 582 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
